name: Houjou Teppei
source:
[url=/c3789]Satoko[/url] and [url=/c3849]Satoshi[/url]'s uncle.

When his brother and sister-in-law passed away, he decided to take them in.

He has a bullheaded, very bad temper, and spends his days violently assaulting Satoko and Satoshi while drinking and gambling.

[spoiler]Teppei and [url=/c3846]Rina[/url] became lovers sometime after the death of the former's wife in 1982 and moved in together at an apartment in Okinomiya. The two make money through gambling and badger games/marriage fraud scams, which involve Rina getting in bed with someone with a lot of money and Teppei catching them in the act, blackmailing and threatening the catch for money.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://07th-expansion.fandom.com/wiki/Teppei_Houjou]Teppei Houjou[/url] on 07th Expansion Wiki]
